notes.title: DiceyHacker1999 Demo Version Now Publicly Released
notes.notes: [p]"In this demo release, you can experience partial idle mechanics and dice-driven combat gameplay. I'll keep updating this trial version with more content and features~[/p][p][/p][p]While many iterations and enhancements are planned, I strongly hope to gather player feedback and suggestions as early as possible. I firmly believe a great game is co-created by developers and players! If you're interested in [i]DiceyHacker1999[/i], join my Discord for early-stage discussions and add the game to your Wishlist!"[/p]
